criteria.requirement: Fix _wrap_text_to_colwidths so blank physical lines between, before and after text are retained as paragraph separators instead of filtered out. Respect existing splitlines terminal-newline convention, width wrapping, whitespace wrapping and numeric bypass behavior; apply consistently to data and headers. Do not broaden blank cells into missing values or change public signatures or upstream expectations unrelated to this bug. Add meaningful render and helper regressions.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
